name: Vibentra v1.3.0 - Offline Mode & Download Vault Update
changelog: ⚡ Full Offline Mode: Download tracks, albums, and playlists directly to device storage for zero-buffering offline playback
📥 Library Download Vault: Dedicated 'Downloaded' section in Library organizing all offline music with file size insights
📴 Zero-Internet Shell: Instant launch without connection errors via Service Worker and auto-fallback offline playback
💾 Local Audio Storage: Full-quality IndexedDB binary audio and artwork vault with storage manager in Settings
📱 Tactile Mobile Gestures: Smooth player pull-down to collapse, swipe up to expand, and track skipping gestures
